method.rth: 09:30 <= t < 16:00 TRUE ET (per-row offset -> UTC -> US-DST-rule ET; frame-agnostic vs the fixed -04:00 cache frame)
method.dedupe: per day, single source file with max RTH bars wins (tie: lexicographically last); rows deduped by timestamp
method.coverage: day included iff >= 30 RTH bars; partial flag if < 70
method.opra: backtest/data/options/SPY<yymmdd><C|P><strike>.csv, size>0; .csv.empty excluded; day must also be in SPY day list
method.day_type: atr20 = mean of prior <=20 covered days' RTH ranges (min 5 else unclassified); range_ratio = range/atr20; body_frac = |close-open|/range; trend: ratio>=1.0 AND body>=0.5; chop: ratio<0.75; range: otherwise
method.vix_band: day_vix = mean RTH VIX close; low<15, mid 15-20, elevated 20-25, high>=25
method.heldout: last ceil(25%) of opra_days by date -- NEVER read during tuning

manual_amendments.what: Flipped has_opra=true + n_opra_files for the 5 trading days that were missing real OPRA fills (2026-07-15, 07-16, 07-20, 07-21, 07-22) after fetching them via backtest/tools/_backfill_opra_recent_gap.py. Did NOT recompute day_type/gap_pct/vix_band/range_ratio for these rows (needs the original inventory-builder's ATR20+VIX pipeline, not reproduced here) and did NOT touch heldout_days (frozen last-25%-by-date boundary; recomputing it now would shift the OOS cutoff).
